guitar.evidence: Duane Allman's Gibson Les Paul (and slide work) and Dickey Betts' Gibson Les Paul/SG use are well documented in Southern rock history.

tone.target: warm clean southern-rock rhythm with light edge
tone.profile: warm clean southern-rock rhythm with light edge
tone.summary: A classic Southern Rock setup utilizing a Comp for soft attack, followed by a low-gain preamp (UK 50) to simulate tube warmth and slight break up, finished with a dry Room reverb.
